display.title: Finale: The Ender Dragon
display.subtitle: Beat the pack, unlock Ad Astra
description: The Ender Dragon is the pack finale. She will not appear until you have
proven yourself in the End: reach the outer islands, find an End City,
slay Shulkers and Endermen, then summon her with a Dragon Summoning
Defeat her and the post-game opens: the road to the stars, Ad Astra.
§7This is the last gate, with no token threshold beyond it. The Dragon
